Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.
 WHY JOIN US
 If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
 ABOUT THE ROLE
 We are looking for a Data Analyst to analyze and visualize large-scale IT infrastructure and asset data, building pipelines and dashboards for internal stakeholders.
 MUST HAVES
 - At least 4 years in Data Analytics , with strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills and a proven track record of solving complex data problems.
- ETL/ELT Processing: Robust experience building ETL/ELT pipelines, ideally utilizing a PySpark / Databricks / Snowflake stack (or equivalent modern cloud technologies).
- Advanced SQL : Strong, production-grade SQL skills for complex querying, data joining, and analytical operations across large-scale systems.
- Large-Scale Asset & Infrastructure Datasets: Hands-on experience working with massive, enterprise-grade datasets related to IT infrastructure, hardware/software assets, network configurations, or cloud resources.
 - Dashboarding & Business Intelligence: Proficient in creating interactive dashboards using Power BI (or similar tools such as Tableau/Qlik) to translate data into business narratives.
- Communication: Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to lead data-focused discussions and customer-facing interactions independently.
- Frontier AI Technologies: Practical knowledge of and experience using cutting-edge AI technologies, Generative AI tools, and LLM framework integrations.
 - Upper-intermediate English level.
 NICE TO HAVES
 - ServiceNow & CMDB: Hands-on experience with ServiceNow data models, Configuration Management Databases (CMDB), or ServiceNow development experience is a huge plus.
- Authoritative Data Source (ADS) Strategy: Experience designing or maintaining strategies for enterprise authoritative data sources.
- Data Governance & Risk Management: Knowledge of enterprise data governance frameworks, compliance standards, internal audit protocols, and risk management processes.
- Data Transformation Expertise: Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end data mapping, complex transformations, and normalization across disparate datasets.
 WHAT YOU WILL DO
 - Data Analysis & Visualization: Design, build, and maintain interactive Power BI (or equivalent) dashboards to deliver clear metrics on enterprise infrastructure, assets, and operational risks.
- ETL/ELT Data Engineering: Develop, optimize, and maintain robust data transformation pipelines processing massive volumes of asset and infrastructure data.
- Stakeholder & Client Leadership: Directly engage with customers, business partners, and engineering teams to identify requirements, translate business needs into data solutions, and independently resolve complex data challenges.
- Data Querying & Modeling: Write complex, optimized SQL queries to manipulate, validate, and extract key insights from multi-source large-scale databases.
- AI & Automation Integration: Evaluate and leverage frontier AI tools and technologies to improve data processing workflows, analytical modeling, and operational efficiency.
- Data Quality & Governance: Assist in defining data mappings, transformations, and schema normalizations to maintain high standards of data integrity.
 PERKS AND BENEFITS
 - Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation : USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects : Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime : Flexible schedule with remote and office options.
 Meet Our Recruitment Process
 Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.
